name: IOCL e-Tendering
notes: Free/official. NIC GePNIC engine, no login required. Homepage widget (10 latest, site-wide) — checked frequently by the workflow schedule to catch it before it rotates off.

name: CPPP / etenders.gov.in
notes: Free/official. Same GePNIC engine as most state e-procurement portals and PSU e-tendering sites. Homepage widget (10 latest, site-wide).

name: Rajasthan e-Tendering
notes: Free/official. Verified live 2026-09-17: no robots.txt restriction. Homepage widget (10 latest, site-wide).

name: Madhya Pradesh e-Tendering
notes: Free/official. Verified live 2026-09-17: no robots.txt restriction. Homepage widget (10 latest, site-wide).

name: NHAI
notes: No separate stable public listing URL as of last check — its tenders flow through CPPP/etenders.gov.in (above) and GeM (blocked, see below). Set url + type to gepnic_table and enabled to true if you confirm a dedicated NHAI e-tendering URL.

name: Maharashtra e-Tendering (mahatenders.gov.in)
notes: Same NIC GePNIC engine as the others, but this specific domain's robots.txt disallows all automated access (checked 2026-09-17: 'Disallow: /'). Do not scrape — this is a real per-domain restriction, not the same as Rajasthan/MP above.

name: GeM (bidplus.gem.gov.in)
notes: Disallows automated access via robots.txt — do not scrape. Use GeM's own keyword/email alert feature instead. (type is intentionally unrecognized by scraper.py so this can't be scraped even if enabled is flipped to true by mistake.)

name: CESL e-procurement (cesl.eproc.in)
notes: Disallows automated access via robots.txt — do not scrape.

name: Telangana e-Procurement
notes: Checked 2026-09-17: neither tender.telangana.gov.in/nicgep/app nor eprocurement.telangana.gov.in/nicgep/app resolved (404) — likely a different engine or a different URL path than the standard GePNIC layout. Needs the correct listing URL confirmed before it can be added.

name: Bihar e-Procurement (eproc2.bihar.gov.in)
notes: Checked 2026-09-17: reachable but not the classic NIC GePNIC layout (no activeTenders table found) — this looks like Bihar's newer 'eProc 2.0' platform, a different engine. Would need its own parser.

name: Gujarat nProcure
notes: Gujarat's official e-tendering platform, but it's run by a different vendor ((n)Code Solutions), not the NIC GePNIC engine — would need its own parser, not yet built.

name: TenderDetail
notes: Paid aggregator you already subscribe to. Scraping a paid product likely breaches its terms of service — use its own keyword/email alert feature instead of building a scraper for it.

name: TendersOnTime
notes: Paid aggregator — use its built-in alerts, don't scrape.
